objective: minimum practical lossless bytes per entity/event

rules.encode: Compact typed columns, short internal keys and small stable enums.
rules.identity: One canonical row per entity; reference stable IDs; never duplicate profiles.
rules.history: Store source facts once; append compact transitions; checkpoint only when measured.
rules.text: Preserve complete meaningful narrative, dialogue, uncertainty, chronology, evidence and provenance.
rules.payload: Relational columns for invariants; bounded versioned JSON only for genuinely variable attributes.
rules.index: Primary/unique/FK and measured query indexes only.
rules.blobs: Use object storage where suitable; retain stable reference, hash, size, media type and provenance.
rules.cache: Derived projections are rebuildable, never authoritative.
rules.retention: Compact/delete only where canon, evidential history and recovery permit.

gate: Before every Neon mutation, measure baseline; estimate incremental bytes and MB/MiB with assumptions and uncertainty; show projected total; wait for explicit approval. If estimate is not credible, benchmark first.
verify: After approved mutation, measure actual database/table/index/TOAST growth and compare with estimate.

historical_baseline.metric: provider logical_size; not comparable to pg_database_size
